title: Fluid Vortex Shedding Behind Obstacles
prompt:
Create a single HTML file with an interactive 2D fluid vortex shedding simulation rendered in Three.js. The simulation uses a grid-based Eulerian fluid solver (marker-and-cell or lattice approach) to demonstrate Kármán vortex streets forming behind obstacles in a flow field.

## Scene Setup
- Use an OrthographicCamera looking down the Z-axis at a 2D fluid domain of size 200 x 80 grid cells.
- Background color: #0a0a1a (dark navy).
- No lights needed; use a ShaderMaterial or DataTexture mapped to a full-screen quad to visualize the fluid field.
- The fluid domain spans the full viewport. Map grid coordinates so X goes left-to-right (inflow on left, outflow on right) and Y goes bottom-to-top.

## Obstacles
- Start with one circular obstacle (radius ~5 cells) centered at grid position (40, 40).
- Obstacles are rendered as white filled circles overlaid on the fluid visualization.
- Users can add rectangular obstacles (8x4 cells) by clicking on the canvas.
- Maximum 5 obstacles total (including the initial circle).
- Each obstacle has a unique integer ID starting from 1.

## Fluid Simulation
- Implement a simplified 2D incompressible Navier-Stokes solver on the grid:
  - Velocity field (u, v) stored per cell.
  - Density/dye field for visualization, injected continuously at the left boundary.
  - Advection step (semi-Lagrangian).
  - Diffusion with viscosity parameter (default 0.001).
  - Pressure projection via Gauss-Seidel iteration (20 iterations default).
  - Boundary conditions: inflow velocity on left (default U=2.0), outflow on right (zero-gradient), no-slip on top/bottom walls and obstacle surfaces.
- The simulation runs at a fixed dt=0.1 per frame.
- Track total kinetic energy: KE = 0.5 * sum(u^2 + v^2) over all fluid cells.
- Track total vorticity magnitude: sum(|curl(v)|) over all cells.
- Track simulation step count.

## Visualization
- Default visualization mode: 'vorticity' — map curl of velocity to a diverging colormap (blue for negative, white for zero, red for positive vorticity).
- Alternative modes: 'velocity' (magnitude mapped to viridis-like gradient), 'pressure' (grayscale), 'dye' (injected dye concentration, cyan-to-magenta).
- Update a DataTexture each frame with the selected field.

## User Interactions
- Keyboard 'V': cycle visualization mode through ['vorticity', 'velocity', 'pressure', 'dye'].
- Keyboard 'R': reset simulation to initial conditions (clear velocity, density, remove all added obstacles, keep only the initial circle).
- Keyboard 'P': toggle pause/resume of the simulation.
- Keyboard ArrowUp / ArrowDown: increase/decrease inflow velocity by 0.5, clamped to [0.5, 5.0].
- Keyboard ArrowLeft / ArrowRight: decrease/increase viscosity by factor of 2, clamped to [0.0001, 0.1].
- Click on canvas: add a rectangular obstacle at the clicked grid position (if under max count).
- Keyboard 'U': undo last added obstacle (remove most recently added rectangle). Does nothing if no user-added obstacles exist.

## HUD / DOM Elements
- A div with id='hud' in the top-left corner (position absolute, color white, font: 14px monospace, background rgba(0,0,0,0.6), padding 10px, z-index 100).
- Display: step count, kinetic energy (2 decimal places), total vorticity (2 decimal places), inflow velocity, viscosity (scientific notation), visualization mode, obstacle count, paused status.
- A button with id='btn-reset' labeled 'Reset' that triggers the same reset as 'R' key.
- A button with id='btn-pause' labeled 'Pause/Resume' that triggers the same as 'P' key.
- A select dropdown with id='select-viz' with options: vorticity, velocity, pressure, dye. Changing it updates the visualization mode.

## State Management
- Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with the following fields updated every frame:
  - simulationStep: integer, increments each unpaused frame
  - paused: boolean
  - vizMode: string, one of ['vorticity','velocity','pressure','dye']
  - inflowVelocity: number (current inflow U)
  - viscosity: number
  - obstacleCount: number (total obstacles including initial)
  - kineticEnergy: number (total KE of fluid)
  - totalVorticity: number (sum of absolute vorticity)
  - gridWidth: 200
  - gridHeight: 80
  - obstacles: array of objects {id, type:'circle'|'rect', cx, cy}
  - lastAddedObstacleId: number or null
  - lastRemovedObstacleId: number or null (set when undo removes one)
  - energyHistory: array of last 60 KE values
  - reynoldsNumber: number (Re = U * D / viscosity, D = obstacle diameter = 10)
  - velocityFieldSample: {u, v} at grid cell (100, 40) — center of domain
  - maxVelocityMagnitude: number (max |v| in the field)
  - pressureIterations: 20
  - dt: 0.1
  - frameTimestamp: performance.now() value at last update
physics_constraints: Incompressible Navier-Stokes: divergence-free velocity field enforced via pressure projection. No-slip boundary on obstacles and walls. Kinetic energy should remain bounded and not diverge to Infinity or NaN. Vortex shedding frequency should increase with Reynolds number. Conservation: total injected momentum at inflow should roughly balance outflow (open boundary). Velocity magnitudes must remain finite and below 10x inflow velocity.
